note: Strategy findings remain proposals until the founder interlock binds them. Neither proposal was applied to any shared route by this attempt.

proposals.proposal: Adopt the terminal-versus-retriable refusal split in the controller-side callback path, not only in this unit.
proposals.rationale: Treating every refusal as final converts a benign ordering fault into silent work loss, because the delivery id is claimed and the corrected retry can never be admitted. Treating every refusal as retriable loses the guarantee that a reused delivery id cannot smuggle a different payload. The split preserves both.

proposals.proposal: Require every controller-recorded RESULT_COMMITTED transition to carry an external effect key, so a commit claim cannot exist without the durable act it asserts.
proposals.rationale: MISSING_REQUIRED_EFFECT makes 'claimed a durable commit but produced nothing' a refusable callback rather than an untestable narrative, which is the same failure class the frozen PO-02 Code-2 packaging fixture represents.
